  | tips                     = 
* {{Minor Artifact|1}}
* This [[Minor Artifact|artifact]] '''cannot''' be upgraded beyond the initial slot despite stating ''"2000 XP for next slot"''.  Any [[Sentient Weapon/Filigrees|Sentient XP]] invested is '''completely wasted'''.
* This item can be used as part of the {{DM's Vision}} item set, along with the [[Mantle of the Worldshaper]] from [[The Abandoned Excavation]]; in this case the Epic Voice will replace the heroic item {{Item|Voice of the Master}}. This will be less useful in the longer run, as both items and indeed the set become pretty weak in high epic levels, and unlike the Epic Voice, the standard heroic Voice can be equipped for the XP bonus while you are wearing another [[Minor Artifact]].
* The Epic Voice cannot be used to craft {{Item|The Master's Gift}}.
* Many players don't slot this trinket (or its [[Voice of the Master|heroic version]]) until just before receiving XP at the end of a quest. When a party is about to fight the final boss or open the last chest, you will often hear a player say "Voices!" as a reminder to the group. In party chat, someone might type "VOM" to show that it's time to slot the trinket.
